Features

Everything your agency needs to run paid ads

Stop switching between ad managers and spreadsheets. Camply puts every client, account and result in one workspace.

Multi-platform management

Meta, Google, TikTok and ChatGPT Ads side by side, each keeping its own campaign structure.

Unified dashboard

Spend, leads, cost per lead and ROAS across every client, compared with the previous period.

Campaign control

Pause and resume campaigns where the platform allows, with every change in the audit log.

Reports and insights

Cross-channel reports with clear metric definitions, ready to export for clients.

Budget and wallet

Client ledgers, monthly budget pacing and GST invoices, kept separate from platform spend.

Team and client access

Give each person the right role and only the clients they work on.

Creative hub Coming soon

One library for images, videos and copy, with client approvals.

Lead inbox Coming soon

Leads from every platform in one pipeline, from new to won.

AI Copilot Coming soon

Ask questions about your campaigns in plain English and get suggested next steps.

How it works

From scattered ad managers to one clear view

  1. 1

    Connect your ad accounts

    Sign in to each platform once. Access tokens are encrypted and never shown in the browser.

  2. 2

    Organise by client

    Assign each ad account to a client. Results sync automatically, with the last sync time always visible.

  3. 3

    Track and act

    Compare platforms, spot underperforming campaigns and make changes, with a full record of who did what.

Integrations

Built around the platforms your clients use

Camply shows what each platform can and can't do through its API, so your team never wonders why a button is missing. Accounts that can't connect yet can still be reported manually.
